description: Create one Notion page per video under a parent page (chapters as headings, paragraphs with timestamp links, a bookmark to the video). Re-exporting updates the same pages instead of duplicating them. Needs NOTION_TOKEN; the parent page comes from parentPageId or NOTION_PARENT_PAGE_ID.

collection.description: A saved collection id to export

parentPageId.description: Notion page id or URL to create the pages under. Default: NOTION_PARENT_PAGE_ID

urls.description: Video, playlist, channel or feed URLs to export

name: export_notion
title: Export to Notion
